prompt.story_prompt: A brave inventor discovers a tiny dragon hiding inside an old library and must help it find its way home.

panels.title: The Discovery
panels.scene_description: Mira discovers a tiny, glowing dragon hiding behind ancient books in the library during an enchanted evening.
panels.caption: The Grand Archives, dusk.
panels.narration: Searching for a misplaced gear, Mira found something far more precious than clockwork.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Well, you're certainly not a manual on hydro-dynamics...

panels.image_prompt: Cinematic realistic art style. Mira, a brave young female inventor with messy brown hair tied in a messy bun, wearing utility goggles on her forehead and a tool belt around her waist, peers behind dusty, ancient books on a wooden library shelf. A tiny, glowing dragon with shimmering golden scales sits curled up between the books, casting a warm light on her amazed face. The library is filled with floating dust motes and warm candlelight in the enchanted evening.

panels.title: The Journey Home
panels.scene_description: Mira guides the tiny dragon out of the library window toward its starry home.
panels.caption: Moments later...
panels.narration: The constellations aligned, signaling it was time for the little traveler to return.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: There you go, little friend. Your sky is waiting.

panels.image_prompt: Cinematic realistic art style. Mira, a brave young female inventor with messy brown hair tied in a messy bun, wearing utility goggles on her forehead and a tool belt around her waist, stands by a tall, open library window. She gently coaxes a tiny, glowing dragon to take flight from her hands into the enchanted evening sky. The background is filled with swirling magical aurora lights and twinkling stars.
